task_type: End-to-end first sales contact with a controlled interruption and explicit callback permission

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Friendly, lightly energetic and natural; keep the opening brief and unhurried.
turns.text: Hello, this is Alex from Willow Home Safety. Thanks for taking my call. Is now a good time for a brief introduction?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.style: Interested but cautious; clear and practical.
turns.text: Yes, I have a minute. I need coverage for three door or sink locations, my upfront limit is sixty dollars, and I don't want a subscription.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Attentive and reassuring; repeat the key constraints clearly.
turns.text: Got it: three locations, no more than sixty dollars upfront, and no monthly plan. I'll check the fit carefully.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Matter-of-fact product explanation, then leave the last word open as if the customer is cutting in.
turns.text: The Willow Sensor kit has three sensors and costs eighty-four dollars once; remote phone monitoring is optional at nine dollars a month, and—

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.style: Polite but firm, slightly urgent; begin while the seller is still speaking, without shouting.
turns.text: Sorry to jump in—sixty dollars is my hard total, and I won't take a monthly plan.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Yielded and empathetic; acknowledge the correction, speak clearly and avoid pressure.
turns.text: Thanks for clarifying. At eighty-four dollars, this kit is outside your limit, so I won't present it as a match. I can check whether a lower-priced three-sensor option with no monthly fee exists, but I can't promise one.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.style: Thoughtful and calm; the request is specific and tentative.
turns.text: That would help. Could you call me on November tenth after ten a.m. UTC, just about an option with no monthly fee?

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Clear, respectful and warm; confirm the exact permission and make no commitment for the customer.
turns.text: With your permission, I'll call on November tenth after ten a.m. UTC about that specific question. There's no purchase or commitment today.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I agree to that phone follow-up. No other contact, please.

overlaps.expected_response: yield to the customer's constraint correction, accurately state the mismatch and obtain specific permission before follow-up
